crossRefs.note: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes; even many…
The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.

people.name: Beth-togarmah
people.line: Region or people group trading with Tyre, allied with Gog.

translations.web: “ ‘ “They of the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, war horses, and mules.
translations.bsb: The men of Beth-togarmah exchanged horses, war horses, and mules for your wares.
translations.kjv: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.
translations.asv: They of the house of Togarmah traded for thy wares with horses and war-horses and mules.
